data.description: Smart EV full E2E teacher verification v4. Ch1: V2 Kripke model (28 states, 47 transitions, 16 CTL properties). Ch2: 6 C functions — 2 safe baselines + 4 bug-injected probes (buffer-overflow, memory-leak, double-free, use-after-free). Ch3: 12 Z3 arithmetic checks covering SOC/TEMP/POWER/CHARGING domains with SAT/UNSAT pairs and overflow probes using production constants. Ch4: 3 Python functions — 2 divide (CWE-369) + 1 magic_value (CWE-798 concolic). Formal and SMT artifacts are grounded in Smart EV requirements and production constants. Ch2/Ch4 generated artifacts are capability probes linked to Smart EV scenarios and are not production-equivalent implementations.

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: Four CWE findings: CWE-121, CWE-401, CWE-415, CWE-416. Classification: BUG_INJECTED_PROBE / PROBE_ONLY; not production REQ PASS/FAIL evidence.
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: Four unsafe tool-capability artifacts: ev_parse_remote_cmd (buffer-overflow), ev_alloc_session_record (memory-leak), ev_release_port_context (double-free), ev_resume_charging_after_fault (use-after-free). These are BUG_INJECTED_PROBE artifacts illustrating vulnerability patterns near Smart EV scenarios. They are PROBE_ONLY and NOT production implementations.
steps: Run teacher static C checker on all 4 generated functions.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch2 static checker: unsafe functions trigger CWE-121/401/415/416

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: SAT: gd12_soc_valid_domain_sat, gd12_soc_update_no_overflow, gd12_soc_full_threshold_sat, gd12_soc_charging_blocked_when_full. UNSAT: gd12_soc_violation_contradiction_unsat. No CWE-190 from gd12_soc_update_no_overflow (bounded by [0,100]).
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: SOC_MIN=0, SOC_MAX=100 from src/core/hang_so.h. Conditions use integer encoding of float bounds.
steps: gd12_soc_valid_domain_sat: condition 'soc>=0 and soc<=100' -> SAT (e.g. soc=4).
gd12_soc_update_no_overflow: bounded update -> SAT, overflow_expr sum<=200 no CWE-190.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: SOC domain contract — 5 SMT checks

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: SAT: overheat_threshold, safe_range, charging_blocked. UNSAT: contradiction. All 4 checks pass.
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: NHIET_DO_TOI_DA=60 (inclusive, >=). Negative lower bound -20 encoded via offset trick to avoid parser UnaryOp error.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: Temperature domain contract — 4 SMT checks

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: All 3 SAT. No int32 overflow within production bounds. Power cap and emergency semantics confirmed satisfiable.
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: CONG_SUAT_CONG_TOI_DA=22kW, SO_CONG_SAC=5, CONG_SUAT_TRAM_TOI_DA=100kW. Max total 5x22=110kW. int32 overflow not possible at this scale.
steps: gd12_power_cap_not_exceeded: 5 ports each [0,22] -> SAT, overflow_expr<=110, no CWE-190.
gd12_charging_rate_positive_time: energy_wh in [0,79200] and time_seconds>0 -> SAT.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch3 Z3: Power and station capacity contract — 3 SMT checks

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: Both functions crash with ZeroDivisionError when denominator=0. CWE-369 classified as PROBE_ONLY. Demonstrates Ch4 pipeline runs end-to-end; not production REQ evidence.
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: ev_charging_power_ratio and ev_token_validation_ratio are TOOL-CAPABILITY ARTIFACTS representing the arithmetic structure of real Smart EV computations. Production uses float arithmetic; probe uses Python integer divide for fuzzing.
steps: Run blackbox_fuzz on ev_charging_power_ratio with arg_types=['int','int'].
Run blackbox_fuzz on ev_token_validation_ratio with arg_types=['int','int'].
Confirm CWE-369 (Divide by Zero) classified for both.
Document as TOOL_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE / PROBE_ONLY; production uses guard time_seconds>0.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch4 black-box fuzz: division-by-zero on charging rate and token ratio

narrative_test_cases.expected_result: Concolic fuzzer finds crash_input={unlock_code_a:4721, unlock_code_b:9033}. CWE-798 finding generated as PROBE_ONLY, not a confirmed production defect.
narrative_test_cases.preconditions: ev_firmware_unlock_gate uses magic_values=[4721, 9033]. Concolic fuzzer uses Z3 symbolic execution to find inputs that trigger the raise. This probes the risk of hardcoded credentials in emergency override paths.
steps: Confirm exception raised at magic_value input.
Classify as CWE-798 (Hardcoded Credentials) or CWE-327.
Document as TOOL_CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE / PROBE_ONLY; production should use cryptographic auth.
narrative_test_cases.title: Ch4 concolic fuzz: firmware unlock gate with Z3-guided input synthesis

requirements.text: Vehicle authentication may succeed only when the vehicle is connected and the token is valid.
When a vehicle disconnects from the station, authentication must be cleared.
Vehicle SOC must remain between 0% and 100%.
A vehicle with SOC at 100% must not continue receiving charging power.
When battery temperature reaches or exceeds 60 C, charging must stop.
A port may enter CHARGING only when a valid vehicle is connected.
At any time, one charging port may be linked to at most one vehicle.
A faulted port must not deliver charging power.
Charging may start only when the vehicle is connected, authenticated, battery and temperature are safe, the port is ready, and no emergency or fault is active.
Charging requires the complete safety gate to remain valid.
Emergency or fault conditions must stop charging and force charging power to zero.

original_document.description: Smart EV full E2E teacher verification v4. Ch1: V2 Kripke model (28 states, 47 transitions, 16 CTL properties). Ch2: 6 C functions — 2 safe baselines + 4 bug-injected probes (buffer-overflow, memory-leak, double-free, use-after-free). Ch3: 12 Z3 arithmetic checks covering SOC/TEMP/POWER/CHARGING domains with SAT/UNSAT pairs and overflow probes using production constants. Ch4: 3 Python functions — 2 divide (CWE-369) + 1 magic_value (CWE-798 concolic). Formal and SMT artifacts are grounded in Smart EV requirements and production constants. Ch2/Ch4 generated artifacts are capability probes linked to Smart EV scenarios and are not production-equivalent implementations.
original_document.name: smart_ev_teacher_e2e_v4

requirements.text: Vehicle authentication may succeed only when the vehicle is connected and the token is valid.
When a vehicle disconnects from the station, authentication must be cleared.
Vehicle SOC must remain between 0% and 100%.
A vehicle with SOC at 100% must not continue receiving charging power.
When battery temperature reaches or exceeds 60 C, charging must stop.
A port may enter CHARGING only when a valid vehicle is connected.
At any time, one charging port may be linked to at most one vehicle.
A faulted port must not deliver charging power.
Charging may start only when the vehicle is connected, authenticated, battery and temperature are safe, the port is ready, and no emergency or fault is active.
Charging requires the complete safety gate to remain valid.
Emergency or fault conditions must stop charging and force charging power to zero.
